goal: Stop scanblocks from silently omitting unindexed blocks and returning incomplete match results
Fail with an explicit error when reading block filters fails, alerting callers to incomplete scans
reviewability: Author needs to address open review objections regarding functional tests and error handling
agreement: Concept approval for preventing silent failures when reading block filters (maflcko, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: functional test relies on races and mines excessive blocks (fjahr)
Questions whether to return partial results instead of erroring when a range is missing (fjahr)
Concern that checking index readiness at scan start may misclassify errors on long scans (fjahr)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it prevents silent data gaps that cause callers to miss transactions in unindexed ranges
Eliminating misleading success responses prevents fund safety and correctness risks for filter users
